text: ‘Globalisation has a positive impact on developing societies.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Governments are unable to prevent the growth of global crime.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Media owners control the content of the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘The growth of the new media has weakened the power of governments.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religion is a force for social change.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘People are less religious today than in the past.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
